title: ScamVerdict
description: Triage verdict emitted by Gemini Nano (parsed and validated) or cloud Gemini (structured output). Nothing is executed unless the raw model output validates against this schema.

verdict.description: SCAM if fraudulent, SUSPICIOUS if unsettled, CLEAR if legitimate, SUBSCRIPTION if a list the user could opt out of, CODE if a login or verification code, OWNED if it is from an account the user owns.

confidence.description: Confidence in this verdict from 0 to 100. Do not use 100.

reasons.description: Up to 3 short, concrete reasons taken from the content.

reputable_official.description: YES if a link uses an official domain of the claimed brand, NO if a look-alike domain is used, UNKNOWN otherwise.

held_account.description: YES if this is from an account the user marked as owned, NO if it is not a saved contact and not owned, UNKNOWN if it is a saved contact but not an owned account.
